Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Backend Engineer | Java, Kotlin, Event-Driven Services
[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN] | [GITHUB]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with professional experience since 2019 building production backend services in Java and Kotlin with Spring Boot. Experienced with REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Kafka, automated testing, Kubernetes-based deployments, and on-call operations. Interested in moving into Python-focused backend development; Python experience to date is limited to scripts for data fixes and small Jenkins helpers.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Java, Kotlin; Python (scripts for data fixes and small Jenkins helpers); Go (learning; personal CLI project).
Backend and APIs: Spring Boot, REST APIs, OpenAPI 3, versioned APIs, rate limiting.
Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, transactional outbox pattern, idempotent consumers.
Testing and tools: Testcontainers, Spring Cloud Contract, Docker, Jenkins helper scripts.
Cloud and platforms: Kubernetes (EKS), AWS EKS, S3 and SQS (service user).

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Backend Engineer, Tejo Insurance Tech | 2022-Present
- Designed a versioned REST API using OpenAPI 3 for insurance brokers; added per-partner rate limiting and contract tests with Spring Cloud Contract. The API supports 12 broker partners and approximately 400,000 quote requests per month.
- Fixed duplicate claim records caused by at-least-once Kafka delivery by implementing a transactional outbox pattern and idempotency keys on consumers; duplicate claims fell from approximately 40 per week to zero over the following quarter.
- Built an internal policy-document service in Kotlin and Spring Boot to render PDFs from templates; it was the company's first Kotlin service, and I wrote the team's Kotlin coding guidelines.
- Participate in an on-call rota one week per month; handled a major Kafka lag incident in March 2024 and wrote a post-incident report that was praised.
- Run the backend guild meeting every two weeks, a responsibility I have held since 2024.

Software Developer, Viajar Online | 2019-2021
- Worked on the booking and payments parts of a large Java application.
- Raised payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70% using Testcontainers, enabling safer refactoring.
- Extracted email and SMS notifications from the booking monolith into a separate Spring Boot service, using RabbitMQ for messaging and Thymeleaf for templating.

ADDITIONAL PROJECT
OpenAPI Spec Diff CLI | Personal learning project
- Building a Go command-line tool to diff OpenAPI specifications; approximately 600 lines of code and available on GitHub. This is a learning project, not a production service.

CERTIFICATION
Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 11 Developer | 2020

LANGUAGE
English: Used as the working language at Tejo Insurance Tech.
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Backend Engineer (Python) role at Tessel Cargo Software. My production backend work has been in Java and Kotlin, languages your job description recognizes as comparable experience, and I am keen to move into a Python-focused backend role. I have used Python for data-fix scripts and small Jenkins helpers; I have not yet shipped a Python service.

At Tejo Insurance Tech, I designed a versioned REST API for broker quote requests that now serves 12 partners and approximately 400,000 requests per month. I also addressed duplicate records caused by at-least-once Kafka delivery, implementing a transactional outbox and idempotency keys that brought duplicate claims from approximately 40 per week to zero over the following quarter. These projects have strengthened my focus on reliable APIs, data correctness, and event-driven services.

I was drawn to the role's combination of event ingestion, Kafka streams, PostgreSQL, and responsibility for services in production. I take part in a one-week-per-month on-call rota and handled a major Kafka lag incident in March 2024, followed by a post-incident report that was praised. I would bring that operational experience, along with hands-on work in Spring Boot, automated testing, Kubernetes, and AWS services, to the Routing & Tracking team.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend experience could contribute to Tessel Cargo Software's shipment-tracking platform.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
